story.title: It is all the cat's fault!
paragraphs_en: Why have you not done your homework? The cat is to blame, teacher.
If she had not climbed the tree and gotten stuck, I would not have taken the ladder to climb it.
If I had not taken the ladder to climb it, I would not have to repair it . If I had not had to repair it, I would not have woken the baby up.
If I had not woken the baby up, my mother would not have rushed out of the kitchen. If my mother had not rushed out of the kitchen, the monkey would not have gotten in.
If the monkey would not have gotten in, he would not have eaten all the food. If he had not eaten all the food, my father would not have bought rotis and chicken curry from the tea-shop.
If my father had not bought rotis and chicken curry from the tea-shop, the dog would not have followed him.
If the dog had not followed him, he would not have eaten my homework.
So, you are saying that the dog ate your homework?
Yes, teacher! It is all the cat's fault!
